title: Fix foundation journey sender input to match deploy contract
head: cloud/gr-base-public-variable-fix-1
body:
The foundation mail-off change moved MAIL_FROM to an optional environment-mapped secret, but the reference journey still added that binding to public vars. The resulting duplicate correctly failed deploy preparation with invalid-public-variable.

Supply the journey sender through its declared mapping, preserving the public sender path for seeds that use vars. Extend the existing deploy flow to assert the mapped binding stays private and duplicate public/secret bindings remain refused. All lifecycle assertions remain.

Validation: reproduced the same real composed-foundation dry-run failing before and passing after input correction; explicit mail-off passes and enabled/missing-mail, contradictory credentials and invalid public values remain refused. Ten targeted tests and reference typecheck pass. Exact-head ordinary Verify and journeys=true qualification are requested. Full-history publication receipt is retained; public-main comparison is pending. No contract status, runtime policy, release version or generated views changed.
